profile.address: Leesburg, VA (True North Data campus, off Thunderball Drive)
profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap record is labeled TikTok Data Center and sits within a data center campus in Leesburg, Virginia, that Loudoun County own zoning and permitting records identify by the project name True North Data. That project name traces to Loudoun County zoning case ZMAP-2017-0003, which rezoned roughly 105 acres to Planned Development-Office Park specifically to allow data center uses and was approved January 18, 2018, on a parcel, county PIN 194103673000, recorded under a condominium-regime plat named True North Land Condo, a structure commonly used to subdivide one large hyperscale campus into separately titled buildings. Direct review of this record own OpenStreetMap edit history, however, shows that the TikTok Data Center name was not present when the building was first mapped in May 2025 under operator True North Data Solutions. It was added six months later, in a November 2025 edit by the same single contributor, whose changeset comment reads only Changed name and whose source field cites nothing more than local knowledge, with no linked news article, corporate filing, or permit record supporting the change. No trade press coverage, Loudoun County zoning-case record, or corporate filing naming TikTok or its parent company ByteDance in connection with this address or the broader True North Data project could be located during this research, given that general web search was unavailable this session, so given the significance of a claim connecting a foreign-owned social media company to a specific piece of American data center infrastructure, this record does not assert TikTok occupancy as fact. It should be read as an unconfirmed, single-source claim pending independent corroboration, presented alongside the same well-documented county zoning and permitting history that applies to every building on this campus, none of which gives a total megawatt capacity, building count, or square footage for the completed campus.

profile.research_note: True North Data Solutions' own site publishes only company-wide totals ("10+ project sites," "673 MW capacity & growing" across 3 countries) with no facility-specific pages or addresses -- corporate office listed is in Calgary, AB. This Leesburg/Loudoun County VA campus (off Thunderball Drive) is reported in local press as a build-to-suit project (Compass Datacenters broke ground for True North); no public per-building spec sheet exists. One row on file is separately named "TikTok Data Center," consistent with reporting that this campus is a single-tenant build-to-suit, which explains the absence of public marketing specs.

reading.body:
This Leesburg campus sits on a 105-acre parcel rezoned in 2018 by Loudoun County specifically for data center use and is operated by True North Data Solutions, a Canadian firm that publishes only a company-wide total of 673 megawatts across 10-plus sites globally, with no facility-specific capacity figures. The campus is mapped as a single building on OpenStreetMap but may contain multiple structures under a condominium regime common to hyperscale campuses, and an unconfirmed, single-source November 2025 edit added the name TikTok Data Center to this facility, a claim with no supporting permit record, news coverage, or corporate filing found during research.

True North Data Solutions publishes no megawatt capacity for this Leesburg site, so its size relative to Virginia's deployed data center infrastructure cannot be ranked from operator claims. The state holds 330 mapped data center facilities but only 23 with published capacity figures totaling 1,375 megawatts, a gap that reflects the industry norm of keeping hyperscale campus specs proprietary. This facility is one of roughly 307 mapped Virginia data centers that operate without public capacity disclosure.

Whether this campus matters to AI scaling depends on the occupancy and workload claims that remain unverified. The zoning approval and parcel records confirm it is a real, permitted data center site built to modern standards, but the single-tenant build-to-suit structure and absence of public specifications mean its power draw, cooling capacity, and actual use case are not documented in any source accessible during this research. Independent corroboration of the TikTok occupancy claim and the facility's actual megawatt draw would be required to assess its role in US AI infrastructure.
